name: Telegram → Task
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Prereq: create the bot with @BotFather, put the token in n8n's Telegram credential
(TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in infra/env/.env is the reference copy).
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Telegram Trigger — on message; long-polls Telegram, so no inbound port is opened
2. IF node — allow only your own chat_id (TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_ID); drop everything else.
The bot is capture-only: incoming text NEVER triggers actions directly, it only
drafts a task that flows through the normal approval pipeline (AGENTS.md).
with source_type='chat' (already allowed by db/schema.sql and the task schema);
or HTTP Request to a small wrapper webhook if you prefer not to exec.
4. Telegram Send — reply with the drafted task title and whether it auto-proceeded
or is waiting in the approval queue (make approve / ntfy push).
Governance: chat capture follows the same rules as voice — the drafting agent runs,
should_require_approval() decides gating, high-risk intents always gate.
